note: Environment-neutral webhook route stubs (ADR 0028, plan unit U5). No secrets — `secret_env` names an env var the operator fills on the Hermes host. Merge routes under platforms.webhook.extra.routes in Hermes config.yaml; not auto-merged by the provisioner today.

routes.name: orbit-email-ingested
routes.prompt: Orbit ingested new email (eventId {eventId}, emailId {emailId}). (1) Contact-enrich: for each material person, set category company|client|vendor OR flag/exclude residents; when a signature/body shows a phone, you MUST call orbit_update_contact with patch.mobile or patch.phone (and title/org when clear). Institutional/campus brands: ownership vs resident — never domain-alone. (2) Work impact: orbit_search / orbit_get_related_context / orbit_open_email; act only if material. (3) Always finish by calling orbit_report_briefing with a short summary, or briefing="[SILENT]" if nothing to surface — that clears the Orbit push banner.
